subject: [hw] DONE V03 rev 4 (R1 F6 fixed)
body:
Rev 4: R1 finding F6 (LOW, non-transactional n2elf_link) fixed.

- n2elf.c: an image whose link attempt fails after relocation started is marked failed; a second n2elf_link returns -1 with "previous link attempt failed after partially applying relocations; the image cannot be retried" instead of re-applying R_ARM_RELATIVE to already-bias-adjusted words. linked is still set only on full success.
- Regression test: liba with its second .rel.dyn entry patched to type 42 -> ERROR link R_ARM_PREL31; the manifest's retry command produces RETRY -1 with that message; the oracle asserts both.
- Last line: bash gpu/hwcodec/loader/test_v03/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V03 PASS 12971/12971
  (oracle 12875 per build ASan+UBSan/-O2, real V02 core 33 per build, reloc unit 61, iOS compile 2; vendor line unchanged: objects 5, relocations 3120, unresolved 146, unique imports 149).
- Commits: 134b059 (F6), c4f80d0 (loader), cb336c5 (STATUS).
Not done unchanged (RELA/TLS/IFUNC/COPY/GNU_RELRO/unload/FINI; single-threaded setup; no phone run). iOS compile-only passes 2/2; t_real now runs the loader against V02's DONE core including the NOIMPORT+name contract and the init chain.
